immutableTechnicalConstraints: Use source and byte-identical backup SHA256 3950226374590a781e8582854f205fb7a3630abece10f6721774b8e986c9dbb5. Candidate must retain all eight approved crate meshes, native modifier settings, local geometry, parenting/transforms and root S0 identity; preserve approved four material graphs and bindings. No added/replaced/deleted or reshaped crate parts.

Use the exact inputs/camera-contract.json world matrix, projection matrix and ortho_scale 1.7256749868392944 at 35 degree elevation and 35 degree azimuth; ordinary orthographic three-quarter, 384x384 at 100 percent and square pixels. Compare numeric camera records, not visual fit. Do not crop/resize/recenter the native export or use a world-render flat card.

Preserve exact approved material, world strength, lights and color response. The approved source contains Cycles, Standard/None, exposure 0, gamma 1, a 210 W centered overhead and four equal 65 W cardinal fills. Any inherited output processing must occur exactly once; no additional grade, exposure tint, raster recoloring or alpha editing.

The PNG must be the actual native RGBA output with clean transparent background, no ground receiver or directional ground cast shadow. Preserve the native-rendered alpha; the old goods alpha mask is diagnostic rather than authority because its geometry predates the approved world refinement.

Keep approved source/backup, world packets/reviews/frames, production renderer, Godot/UI files and all floors untouched. Candidate source/recipe and copied consumer evidence belong to this supplement only.

Preserve the six goods identities, atlas cell conventions and existing consumer labels, stock/count text, controls, cream surfaces and phone/landscape layout. Floor-cream must retain source PNG SHA256 6ded9330f3106d1d4941ac84e94c3e54436f098d261f5f36436d7115af239177 and exact atlas crop RGBA bytes from region [788,396,384,384] with RGBA pixel SHA256 1cee44c04199f35fd17b2774d667dfa7ed95656ad2b8f88f16df628d2d8a1ce1.

aestheticCriteria.shapeVolume: The native three-quarter image clearly exposes the same crate lid plus front and right side. The approved rounded lid boards, continuous perimeter rim, front diagonal brace and corner junctions retain their actual depth and contacts; no flat world sprite or separately invented three-quarter model.
aestheticCriteria.color: The approved honey/golden lid, amber timber frame/brace and warm brown inset remain recognizable in the UI view. On current cream cards, face and rim separation must remain clear; do not tune the palette away from the approved source to resemble the target more closely.
aestheticCriteria.lightingHighlights: The existing source response should reveal restrained rounded edge catches and soft volume across the lid, brace and corners. Avoid blown white bands, broad black dead spots, over-dark front/right faces or a second contrast/brightness pass. Differences caused by the exact goods camera are allowed.
aestheticCriteria.materialDetail: Read as the same simplified finished timber as the approved world crate, with separate boards and construction contacts. No new grain, ornament, plastic white gloss or detail treatment is required or authorized.
aestheticCriteria.intendedSizeReadability: Inspect the entire unchanged 384x384 canvas scaled to 66x66 and 96x96 pixels, without cropping to occupied pixels. At 66 px the crate silhouette, lid/front/right face separation and diagonal brace must remain identifiable on the actual cream card. At 96 px individual lid boards, rounded perimeter and corner construction must remain readable. Fine bevels need not each resolve at 66 px.
aestheticCriteria.artifactFree: No frame clipping, isolated alpha fragments, colored fringe, holes, black seam patches, coplanar overlap, separated brace ends, broken corners, abrupt normals, detached components or shadow residue. Inspect full native pixels and light/gray/dark backgrounds, then current cream-card consumer at phone and landscape sizes.

requiredCandidateEvidence: Immutable packet binds brief/frozen criteria, exact approved source/backup, saved candidate blend, exact recipe, native goods.png, validation, reopen proof and every preview/context image/resource.

Native records compare source versus candidate geometry/evaluated shape, modifier settings, transforms/parenting, root S0, material graphs/bindings, lights/world and color pipeline; changed-camera/resolution/pixel-aspect exceptions explicitly enumerated. Show dependency closure and no raster image/card substitution.

Saved blend must be reopened in a fresh Blender process and render the same UI camera. Bind its reopened render and proof of matching pixels/declared deterministic comparison to the candidate. A save log without actual reopened pixels is insufficient.
logical-backgrounds preview includes full-canvas 66 and 96 px renders on light/current cream, gray and dark backgrounds. Enlarged inspection must keep source registration intact.

context-card uses copied current real Godot card consumer, not a hand-drawn approximation; show the crate with existing labels/counts and other goods in phone and landscape contexts, with unchanged UI source hashes and only the candidate goods substitution scoped to the copy.
Preservation checks bind the current six goods identities and verify floor-cream source bytes and atlas crop pixels exactly. No other object is aesthetically graded by this crate review.

qualityCriteria.approvalRule: Approve only the exact hash-bound native UI candidate with proven geometry/material/light/camera parity, actual reopened-render evidence, visible quality/readability and unchanged current consumer/floor context. Missing evidence is not approval. If the locked approved geometry creates a newly exposed material defect, report the specific constraint conflict through the coordinator rather than silently changing the model or lowering the bar.
